Web creates and edits no preset: the configuration viewer is read-only, and a bundle installed through Creator mode declares a new preset or overrides a shipped one by row id, replacing its complete child list.

title: **No mailbox timeline** — the panel displays tasks, not messages.

attrs.text: **No mailbox timeline** — the panel displays tasks, not messages.

title: **No lifecycle or workspace controls** — the panel cannot spawn, rename, delete, or interrupt teammates, and write scopes remain advisory metadata.

attrs.text: **No lifecycle or workspace controls** — the panel cannot spawn, rename, delete, or interrupt teammates, and write scopes remain advisory metadata.

title: **Inline local images require an HTTP(S) page**: Desktop’s `dsh-app:` pages do not support this file route. POSIX absolute paths and Windows drive-letter paths are supported; relative Chat image paths require the viewed Session’s workspace ...

attrs.text: **Inline local images require an HTTP(S) page**: Desktop’s `dsh-app:` pages do not support this file route. POSIX absolute paths and Windows drive-letter paths are supported; relative Chat image paths require the viewed Session’s workspace root. Separate image file links are optional.

title: **Mention matching uses exact paths, unique argument aliases, or unique basenames only** — a suffix mention stays inert; widening the matcher is deferred until a real closing-message shape needs it.

attrs.text: **Mention matching uses exact paths, unique argument aliases, or unique basenames only** — a suffix mention stays inert; widening the matcher is deferred until a real closing-message shape needs it.

title: **Terminal-created files require explicit delivery** — the card lists them once git records the change, but delivery cards and inline-code references require `present`; explicit Markdown links can reference existing files directly.

attrs.text: **Terminal-created files require explicit delivery** — the card lists them once git records the change, but delivery cards and inline-code references require `present`; explicit Markdown links can reference existing files directly.

title: **Declarations do not preserve file contents** — reopening or transferring a Session requires source files accessible through the viewed Session’s filesystem. Missing files, directories, and final symbolic links return 404.

attrs.text: **Declarations do not preserve file contents** — reopening or transferring a Session requires source files accessible through the viewed Session’s filesystem. Missing files, directories, and final symbolic links return 404.

title: **Native opening needs a Host desktop** — without one the review tab offers no native open; the comparison itself needs only the Host that recorded the turn.

attrs.text: **Native opening needs a Host desktop** — without one the review tab offers no native open; the comparison itself needs only the Host that recorded the turn.

title: **Comparison highlighting is hunk-local** — each rendered old and new hunk side is tokenized independently because omitted source lines are unavailable; unknown suffixes remain plain, and the tab draws at most 5,000 lines before saying so.

attrs.text: **Comparison highlighting is hunk-local** — each rendered old and new hunk side is tokenized independently because omitted source lines are unavailable; unknown suffixes remain plain, and the tab draws at most 5,000 lines before saying so.

title: **Comparisons carry whole file text** — the comparison route serves a listed file's complete text wherever the Host recorded it, including ignored files and files outside the workspace root the Sidebar previews are confined to.

attrs.text: **Comparisons carry whole file text** — the comparison route serves a listed file's complete text wherever the Host recorded it, including ignored files and files outside the workspace root the Sidebar previews are confined to.

title: **Files outside the workspace open by absolute path only** — the recorded path is the Host path at recording time; a moved workspace or a different viewing Session cannot relocate it.

attrs.text: **Files outside the workspace open by absolute path only** — the recorded path is the Host path at recording time; a moved workspace or a different viewing Session cannot relocate it.

title: **Channel labels are not rendered** — stdout and stderr chunks concatenate into one stream; per-channel tinting is a presentation follow-up.

attrs.text: **Channel labels are not rendered** — stdout and stderr chunks concatenate into one stream; per-channel tinting is a presentation follow-up.

title: Saved records describe inbox delivery, not execution results; absent historical prompts or physically deleted tasks cannot be reconstructed.

attrs.text: Saved records describe inbox delivery, not execution results; absent historical prompts or physically deleted tasks cannot be reconstructed.

title: The Host limits saved history by `deliveryHistoryDays` and `deliveryHistoryRecords`; page size limits record count, not prompt bytes.

attrs.text: The Host limits saved history by `deliveryHistoryDays` and `deliveryHistoryRecords`; page size limits record count, not prompt bytes.

title: Conversation links open the Session through normal navigation, not a specific message. Deleting a task does not cancel messages already delivered.

attrs.text: Conversation links open the Session through normal navigation, not a specific message. Deleting a task does not cancel messages already delivered.

title: This UI provides no task-level authorization for model tools. Host Schedule owns access control and must enforce any per-Session restrictions.

attrs.text: This UI provides no task-level authorization for model tools. Host Schedule owns access control and must enforce any per-Session restrictions.

title: **Non-completed inactive outcomes remain grouped** — the catalog distinguishes a latest normal completion from other inactive states, but does not distinguish failure, cancellation, refusal, token exhaustion, or a child with no closed turn;...

attrs.text: **Non-completed inactive outcomes remain grouped** — the catalog distinguishes a latest normal completion from other inactive states, but does not distinguish failure, cancellation, refusal, token exhaustion, or a child with no closed turn; the UI exposes no Activation identity, and stopping is limited to the composer's current-turn Stop for a running continuable child.

title: **Ancestor menus require keyboard activation for uncached branches** — hovering does not read, and clicking the ancestor title navigates. Focus the title and press ArrowDown to prepare that level without leaving the current Session.

attrs.text: **Ancestor menus require keyboard activation for uncached branches** — hovering does not read, and clicking the ancestor title navigates. Focus the title and press ArrowDown to prepare that level without leaving the current Session.

title: **Level discovery stops on interruption** — an unexpected read rejection stops later siblings and is logged to the console. A reconnect can interrupt discovery before direct children are read; explicitly reopen the menu to prepare the level...

attrs.text: **Level discovery stops on interruption** — an unexpected read rejection stops later siblings and is logged to the console. A reconnect can interrupt discovery before direct children are read; explicitly reopen the menu to prepare the level again.

title: **The Session panel section has no level activation** — showing the section reads nothing, so a direct subagent whose catalog the Session list has not cached offers no expansion arrow there until its catalog arrives, for example after its o...

attrs.text: **The Session panel section has no level activation** — showing the section reads nothing, so a direct subagent whose catalog the Session list has not cached offers no expansion arrow there until its catalog arrives, for example after its own conversation opens or a sibling's breadcrumb switcher prepares the level.

title: **`@` references remain display-title text** — duplicate or renamed labels are ambiguous, so they intentionally do not acquire continuation semantics.

attrs.text: **`@` references remain display-title text** — duplicate or renamed labels are ambiguous, so they intentionally do not acquire continuation semantics.

title: **Tool-change presentation** — Tool-only developer messages name a single added or removed tool inline without expansion. Multiple changes show added/removed counts and expand to comma-separated tool lists, one line per change kind. Mixed c...

attrs.text: **Tool-change presentation** — Tool-only developer messages name a single added or removed tool inline without expansion. Multiple changes show added/removed counts and expand to comma-separated tool lists, one line per change kind. Mixed content uses the generic context presentation.

title: **In-flight Time stays blank** — `partial` and `runningCalls` rows show their running state without a fabricated duration, so the Overview renders a start marker rather than inventing a live span. Record and timeline selection are local to ...

attrs.text: **In-flight Time stays blank** — `partial` and `runningCalls` rows show their running state without a fabricated duration, so the Overview renders a start marker rather than inventing a live span. Record and timeline selection are local to Trajectory, with no anchor deep links.

title: **Only top-level calls through `dsh-tool-workflow` produce these records** — nested PTC mode calls and direct `WorkflowEngine` consumers do not.

attrs.text: **Only top-level calls through `dsh-tool-workflow` produce these records** — nested PTC mode calls and direct `WorkflowEngine` consumers do not.

title: **A run lost without terminal events in a normally ended Turn stays running** — for example a background run whose process crashed during a later Turn, or a run whose recording stopped after a failed append; the session log carries no fact ...

attrs.text: **A run lost without terminal events in a normally ended Turn stays running** — for example a background run whose process crashed during a later Turn, or a run whose recording stopped after a failed append; the session log carries no fact that marks it stopped.

title: **Navigation is intentionally live-only** — terminal members remain visible for review but never expose a cold-session opener from this node.

attrs.text: **Navigation is intentionally live-only** — terminal members remain visible for review but never expose a cold-session opener from this node.

title: **The node shows run, phase, member identity, and status only** — scripts, outputs, errors, logs, usage, static topology, and controls remain outside this surface.
